name: Technology and Core Infrastructure
blurb: What AI is built from: the models themselves, the silicon and datacenters they run on, the APIs and datasets that feed them, and the languages, frameworks, agents, and protocols developers use to build with them.

domains.name: Foundation Models

sections.name: Scientific Models

sections.name: Model Serving Providers
sections.blurb: The companies that actually run the inference behind AI model APIs: 100+ serving providers with headquarters country, datacenter regions, and links to each one's terms of service, privacy policy, and live status page. Headquarters and datacenter jurisdiction determine which AI regulations (EU AI Act, data residency, export controls) apply to a deployment, which is why this directory joins operations data to governance. Sourced daily from the OpenRouter routing catalog.
